polls.description: Major security incidents and geopolitical tensions involving Chinese AI tools, cyberattacks, and blocked business deals amid US-China tech rivalry.
polls.question: Should Western nations escalate restrictions on Chinese AI technology?

cluster_stories.title: India flags Chinese-linked AI tools in hacking campaign against financial firms
cluster_stories.summary: India's cybersecurity agency named the hacking group behind a wave of AI-driven attacks on financial firms and identified its tools, at least two of them linked to China, adding India to a growing list of countries where
cluster_stories.headline: INDIA EXPOSES CHINESE AI TOOLS IN FINANCIAL HACKING WAVE

cluster_stories.title: China blocks SoftBank's $5.4 billion takeover of ABB's robotics division: FT
cluster_stories.summary: Softbank had agreed to buy ABB's robotics business in October last year, as CEO Masayoshi Son sought to establish SoftBank as a core player in the development of artificial intelligence.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS SOFTBANK'S $5.4B ABB ROBOTICS TAKEOVER

cluster_stories.title: Oracle abandons $7 billion Tencent AI deal under Trump pressure: FT
cluster_stories.summary: US officials approached Oracle to raise concerns about the Tencent deal, the newspaper said, citing people familiar with the matter.
cluster_stories.headline: ORACLE KILLS $7B Tencent AI Deal Under Trump Pressure

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia orders data centre clients to reduce China exposure
cluster_stories.summary: World’s biggest chipmaker tells cloud computing providers a majority of their clients must be non-Chinese
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA ORDERS DATA CENTERS: CUT CHINA EXPOSURE

cluster_stories.title: SK Hynix's New York chip plans hit snag over US restrictions on China, sources say
cluster_stories.summary: SK Hynix is seeking US export licenses to equip its Dalian plant, arguing that increased production there would help fund its planned US expansion. But the Commerce Department has yet to approve the new licenses, the people said. Its Solidigm unit plans to invest about $45 billion and build two NAND plants in Marcy, New York, two people said, with investment potentially reaching about $100 billion over time. NAND is memory that retains data even when power is turned off and is used for storage in data centers.
cluster_stories.headline: SK Hynix NY Chip Plans Hit Wall Over China Restrictions

polls.description: Record-breaking funding rounds and infrastructure spending signal an AI investment boom despite growing concerns about costs and sustainability.
polls.question: Is the AI infrastructure spending boom sustainable or heading for a crash?

cluster_stories.title: South Korea will nearly double AI spending to $16B in a record budget
cluster_stories.summary: South Korea will spend 21.3 trillion won (about $16 billion) on AI, chips and AI data centres next year. cluster_stories.headline: SOUTH KOREA DOUBLES AI SPENDING TO $16B in Record Budget

cluster_stories.title: China’s Largest Startup Deal Ever Lifts Global Venture Funding To $59B In October
cluster_stories.summary: Global venture funding in October totaled $59 billion, a 45% jump from a year earlier, per Crunchbase data, in large part due to a record-setting $15.9 billion funding round for China’s DeepSeek.
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK RAISES $15.9B... LARGEST STARTUP DEAL EVER

cluster_stories.title: Google unveils $15 billion data centre investment in Malaysia
cluster_stories.summary: Google announced plans on Wednesday to invest $15 billion in Malaysia over the next two years to build data centres and other infrastructure as demand booms for artificial intelligence services. It said the $15 billion investment will be made "over the next two years (2027 to 2028)", expanding on a $2 billion investment announced in 2024.
cluster_stories.headline: GOOGLE DROPS $15 BILLION on Malaysia AI Data Centres

cluster_stories.title: Google to Spend $15 Billion in Malaysia Data Center Expansion
cluster_stories.summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google said it plans to spend $15 billion to expand data center and cloud operations in Malaysia as the artificial intelligence boom fuels demand for digital infrastructure.
cluster_stories.headline: GOOGLE DROPS $15B on Malaysia AI Data Centers

cluster_stories.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its value to $16B in a $1.3B round
cluster_stories.summary: Fal, which hosts image, video and audio AI models for developers, raised $1.3B led by Bessemer at a $16B valuation, double its April value. Nvidia and T. cluster_stories.headline: AI Inference Startup Fal DOUBLES to $16B in Mega $1.3B Round

cluster_stories.title: Goldman, Apollo in Talks to Sell SpaceX’s $40 Billion AI Deal
cluster_stories.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and Apollo Global Management Inc. are in talks with Wall Street investors to start selling portions of a roughly $40 billion chip financing deal for SpaceX, just as the AI boom braces for upheaval following a sweeping Democratic victory.
cluster_stories.headline: Goldman, Apollo Shop SpaceX's $40B AI Chip Deal
